items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He taught me, he had two guitars and showed me how to finger it.

ctx.x: So tell us about how you picked up guitar and who was the person that taught you?

I just liked the sound. When I used to work a lot at my uncle’s cleaners and when I got off I used to pass a place where they sold bootleg beer and whiskey. I’d drop in to listen to Red, the guy who ran the place, play his guitar. That’s the only reason I went in

there. He would just play all night, cause he loved to play guitar. All these different songs that he could play, and he was real, he sort of sounded like Lightening Hopkins. He taught me, he had two guitars and showed me how to finger it.
